annotations.title: Free alerts: car price drops and local fuel prices

description: Free MotifyMe email alerts: an alert when the price drops on a car listed on the MotifyMe marketplace (set up from the car's listing page), and fuel price alerts for a chosen area and fuel, set up on the MotifyMe fuel price pages or on WhatsApp by sending FUEL ALERT. Returns the links to set each up.
